scenes.text: Your account is in the red. The debt is bigger than anything you own. Every phone call feels like another bill you can't pay.
So you hide. You ignore the messages. You pretend it'll go away. It won't.
Here's what a man does. He sits down, grabs a piece of paper, and writes down every single debt. Every name. Every number.
He faces it. Then he picks the smallest one and attacks it. Pay it off. Cross it out. Move to the next.
Debt is just a number. It's not who you are. It's not your name, and it's not your future.
Starting from zero is hard. Starting from minus is harder. But it's still a start.
Every payment you make is a piece of your freedom coming back. So grab the paper. Write it down. Tonight.
